mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of the instances following a 3-month FEDFUNDS decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month indicates a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and RSAFS drops > 2% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is stagnant or declining, it signals a supply-side constraint, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.
